incidents.body:
Forcepoint is actively monitoring the situation and working internally to identify alternatives to restore services. Until the region stabilizes, customers are encouraged to contact Forcepoint’s Technical Support Team to discuss alternative recovery options.
 
Customer Impact
Some Forcepoint services are affected due to ongoing outages at our public cloud provider. Customers using the following services in the me-central-1 and me-south-1 regions may experience availability issues:
 
- Remote Browsing Isolation (RBI): Customers connecting to Forcepoint's RBI services will not be able to browse via RBI.
- Cloud DLP for Email:  Customers connecting to Cloud DLP for email solutions may experience their outbound emails being queued up or experience a delivery failure. 
- Insights: Access in the me-central-1 and me-south-1 regions are impacted.
- Forcepoint ONE SSE: Impact has been mitigated by routing traffic to an alternate region.
incidents.title: Impact on Services in UAE and Bahrain Regions

incidents.body:
Customer Impact: AMDP customers may experience minor latency with real-time scanning of files and content while services are failed over to a redundant data center.
 
Current Status : We have identified the problem to be related to one of our malware sandboxing providers. We have receive confirmation from the Vendor on stability of their infrastructure and have re-balanced AMDP services across Paris and San Jose. 

This incident has been resolved.

Customer Impact: Impact was immediately mitigated as Web Security service traffic for the PNHA vPoP was automatically failed over to a redundant data center. Customers connecting to PNHA vPoP configured in Singapore data center may observe a loss of localization while accessing the Web. 

Current Status: We have restored access to PNHA vPoP services within Singapore (Cluster R) and traffic has been automatically re-introduced.

incidents.body:
Customer Impact: A few of our customers may experience challenges when accessing Microsoft Teams' chat feature via a browser while using Forcepoint's reverse proxy (CASB) service. All functionalities of Microsoft Teams remain fully accessible when using the desktop application. The impact is limited to customers using Teams through a browser. No other application is impacted, and customers using the Forcepoint Endpoint Agent are unaffected. 

Current Status: The issue has been resolved, and normal functionality has been restored. A simple browser refresh is required for the fix to take effect.
incidents.title: Microsoft Teams Chat Access Impacted via FONE Reverse Proxy

incidents.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) has confirmed that the issue affecting services in the us-east-1 region has been resolved.
For more details on the AWS outage, please access AWS Status page using the link below.

https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status

The  outage has unfortunately impacted some Forcepoint products which are dependent on AWS infrastructure and services.

We can confirm that all impacted Forcepoint services have now fully recovered
